metadata.case_title: Commissioner Of Income Tax vs Khan And Sirohi Steel Rolling Mills
metadata.summary: The case involved questions of law referred by the Tribunal under the IT Act, 1961 regarding addition of Rs. 13,96,080 and inflated stock figures. The assessee, engaged in re-rolling of M.S. rods, had discrepancies in stock valuation against the overdraft obtained. The Tribunal, CIT(A), and the Tribunal again differed in their decisions on the additions made by the ITO. The Tribunal accepted the explanation of inflating stock values for bank drafts, citing precedents. The Court upheld the Tribunal's decision, emphasizing the lack of verification by bank officials and prevalent business practices.
